# Scroll area

A region with its own styled scrollbars.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Accessible first</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-scroll-area--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:accessible-first;mode:light" title="Scroll area examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-scroll-area--docs">Open Scroll area in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-scroll-area--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:accessible-first;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Accessible first:** A fixed-height list or panel inside a page that still works at 200% zoom. Not the whole page.

- **Use it when:** A fixed-height list or panel inside a larger page.
- **Not when:** The whole page: let the page scroll.

Instead:

- [Message scroller](./message-scroller.md): A conversation that keeps the newest in view.

## Words

- Use common words. Explain any term you must use.
- One idea per sentence. Put the action first.
- Never blame the person.
- Use: Continue, Change, Start, You. Avoid: Invalid, Utilise, Submit, Error code.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Continue
- `content.action.cancel`: Go back
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Start a new application

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | The region can be focused and scrolled with the keyboard. | undefined |



## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add scroll-area
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Scroll area reads 6 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Scroll area's tokens to change Scroll area alone.
